solver: scipy NNLS; original frozen per-gene row scales; sum-normalized coefficients
missing_gene_rule: Intersect available genes; no imputation or new selection
primary_expression_transform: Assume log2(x+1), invert as 2^value - 1; normalize all 20501 expression genes to sum 10000
cutpoint: Global median across all 206 tumor expression samples; High>median, Low<=median; no survival-based optimization
clinical_join_requirement: Exact full tumor patient identifiers plus independent age agreement; flagged L/H matrix aliases require additional identity evidence before clinical linkage
endpoints: Only directly recorded valid time and event pairs; do not relabel DSS as OS, or RFS/DFS as PFS
survival_plan: If clinical files are retrieved and verified: Kaplan-Meier with risk tables, logrank test, binary and per-SD continuous Cox; BH correction across the main available endpoints. No p-value exists yet.
interpretation: Exploratory RNA-reference coefficient, not validated cell abundance.
